purpose: Test victim feasibility only with a full-data official-style 28x28 ResNet-18 before authorizing any clean-pair or detector experiment.
hash_design: The protocol does not embed its own digest. The runner, checkpoints, manifest and verifier compute the complete protocol-file SHA-256 at runtime, avoiding a self-hash cycle.

dataset.name: PathMNIST
dataset.training_scope: all official training rows with their natural class frequencies

attack.construction: in-place image replacement and target-label overwrite; dataset length and original indices preserved

training.primary_checkpoint: highest clean validation macro one-vs-rest AUC observed during the fixed 100 epochs; earliest epoch wins exact ties

evaluation.primary_clean_metric: balanced accuracy on the untouched official test split
evaluation.attack_metric: target-class attack success rate on patched official non-target test rows
evaluation.test_timing: only after all training and clean-validation checkpoint selection for a seed are complete

gate.pass: both seeds 93 and 94 complete formally and both primary best-clean-validation-AUC checkpoints satisfy both victim thresholds
gate.pass_action: authorize a separately frozen clean-pair/detector protocol
gate.fail_action: retain the victim-feasibility failure and do not run detectors or a clean pair

dry_run.purpose: static integration and exact-resume testing only
